links.outcome: LLM response accuracy and practicality in Chinese versus English queries
links.effect: Accuracy and practicality of ChatGPT-E were significantly higher than ChatGPT-C and EB for both questionnaires (all Ps<.001).
links.quote: Overall, for both the patient and expert questionnaire, the accuracy and practicality of responses from ChatGPT-E were significantly higher than those from ChatGPT-C and EB (all Ps<.001).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of LLM (ChatGPT and ERNIE Bot) responses to breast cancer questions across patient and specialist query sets using expert Likert-scale ratings, without testing specific deployment safeguards.
